days.label: Day 1
days.title: Arrive in Gangtok
days.text: Pickup from NJP or Bagdogra and a scenic drive to Gangtok. Evening on MG Marg.

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Tsomgo Lake and Baba Mandir
days.text: Full-day excursion to the high-altitude lake. We arrange the permits.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Monasteries and viewpoints
days.text: Rumtek Monastery, Ganesh Tok and the Do-Drul Chorten, with time for momos.

days.label: Day 4
days.title: Ropeway and leisure
days.text: Gangtok ropeway, the flower exhibition centre and a free afternoon.

days.label: Day 5
days.title: Departure
days.text: Breakfast, then a drop to NJP or Bagdogra.
